note: Eval scoreboard feed for /skills/ (runs and triggers, shape in README.md). runs are copied from evals/runs/<round>/results.json; a row of a multi-sample round holds the per-brief means over its samples. triggers come from the triggers-<suite>.md role view. The dated artifacts are written into the pages as static HTML and linked relatively to the files in this folder.
